Risk terminology update

This is an archived EDA output snapshot. The current notebook source includes clarified terminology: lifetime charge-off probability (resolved 36-month cohort), with Charged Off = 1 and Fully Paid = 0; other statuses are excluded. This is not a 12-month forecast or a Basel default probability. EAD/LGD are retrospective snapshot proxies. The loss composition is a lifetime snapshot-loss proxy. Capital scenarios use separately assumed one-year PDs; they do not use or annualise the classifier score. Legacy PD/Basel names in the saved outputs should be read with these definitions.

Full risk terminology. Saved tables and figures below have not been recomputed.
